heading: Today
text: Mostly cloudy, with scattered morning showers, especially southwest of I-89, diminishing this afternoon.  Periods of sun developing in the valleys, mostly south.  Highs in the 40s to low 50s.  Light winds, becoming northwest near 10 mph, gusting 20 to 30 mph this afternoon.

heading: Tonight
text: Mostly cloudy.  A few localized rain or wet snow showers over the higher terrain.  Lows in the 30s, near 30 across the higher elevations north.  Winds northwest 10 to 15 mph, gusting 20 to 30 mph, diminishing to light overnight.

heading: Tuesday
text: Mostly cloudy, with intervals of sun south.  A rising chance of rain showers north near midday in northern NY, spreading east in the afternoon.  Highs in the upper 40s to mid 50s, some mid 40s far north.  Winds becoming southwest near 10 mph, gusting 20 to 30 mph in the afternoon.
